From the diagram, we see that $f(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=0$ and ${x}_{2,3}=-1\pm 2\text{i}.$ Additionally, we're given that the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=4.$ Therefore, we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x) & =a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) \\  & =4(x-0)(x-(-1+2\text{i}))(x-(-1-2\text{i})) \\  & =4x(x-(-1+2\text{i}))(x-(-1-2\text{i}))\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}4x(x-(-1+2\text{i}))(x-(-1-2\text{i})) & = \\ 4x({x}^{2}-x(-1-2\text{i})-x(-1+2\text{i})+(-1+2\text{i})(-1-2\text{i})) & = \\ 4x({x}^{2}+2x+5) & = \\ 4{x}^{3}+8{x}^{2}+20x & .\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $f(x)=4{x}^{3}+8{x}^{2}+20x.$
